title: Squared operator norm is at most the squared Hilbert-Schmidt norm
statement: For all natural numbers m, k and every continuous linear map Q : R^m -> R^k (Q : Rn m →L[ℝ] Rn k), ||Q||^2 <= sum_{a in Fin m} ||Q e_a||^2, where ||Q|| is the operator norm and e_a = EuclideanSpace.single a 1.
lean_statement: ∀ m k : ℕ, ∀ Q : Rn m →L[ℝ] Rn k, ‖Q‖ ^ 2 ≤ ∑ a : Fin m, ‖Q (EuclideanSpace.single a (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2
